description: Mysterious fragment, possibly a letter fragment. Mainly in Judaeo-Arabic. Dating: Late, perhaps 17th–19th century based on the paleography. A signature appears at the bottom that was probably crossed out intentionally, it reads: Barūkh(?) Ḥaqīm. The word הצעיר that commonly appears with signatures is badly mispelled: הסעייר. Needs examination.
description_he: קטע מסתורי. בעיקר ביהודית-ערבית. תאריך: מאוחר, אולי המאות ה-17–19. דרוש בחינה.
